clue.text: Something run by Playboy hostess missing New York — sweet thing

parts.note: a Playboy Club hostess is called a bunny

explanation.surface: Someone runs a business with a Playboy hostess who has left New York, and calls her a sweet thing.
explanation.walkthrough: A Playboy Club hostess wore a rabbit costume and was known by that animal's pet name. A Bath bun is a sweet currant bun named after the city of Bath in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bath bun is a sugary yeasted bun, so it is a sweet thing in the confectionery sense.

clue.text: Dinky model also known as Hornby

explanation.surface: A Dinky toy car is also sold under the Hornby name, both being classic British toy brands.
explanation.walkthrough: Dinky and Hornby look like the British toy brands (Dinky die-cast cars were made by Frank Hornby's firm), fitting the toy theme, but one is an adjective and the other a surname.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin as a twig describes something dainty and slight; the model's nickname came from her slender build.

clue.text: Does she sort train journeys with Mum — cracking offer?

explanation.definitionFit: A bride's attendant often straightens and carries the trailing back of the wedding gown.

clue.text: Upending tin over most of spicy Mexican food

At home drama was shown on time without fail

clue.text: Idiot parking right by a junction
